Verma Verma

Antra

Full Stack Developer

+91 7903165482

antra9893171@gmail.com

https://www.linkedin.com/in/antraverma96

https://github.com/vermicelliCodes/localRepo/

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Pursuing challenging assignments in full stack and back-end development roles, utilizing proficiency in Java to drive impactful solutions in a collaborative and dynamic work environment.

WORK EXPERIENCE Software Engineer – General Electric, Hyderabad, India (Aug 2021 – Mar 2025) Project: SIM Deployment(B2B)

Led the creation of user-friendly interfaces using React and Java, improving user engagement by 20% with strong concepts of HTML and CSS.

Integrated APIs for optimized data communication, enhancing data transfer times by 15%.

Managed data with MongoDB and MySQL using stored procedures, achieving 30% faster data retrieval.

Hands-On experience in state management of components with Redux and React Context API and utilization of frameworks like Tailwind CSS and Ant Design in projects.

Enhanced UX with web-hooks for instant notifications, increasing user engagement by 40%.

Skilled in developing RESTful APIs and server-side logic using SpringBoot and Microservices.

Utilized Kafka for high throughput,real time data feeds from different IoT systems to the backend.

-Integrated with the CI/CD pipeline to ensure frequent, automated testing and delivery of new features.

System Engineer – Infosys Ltd, Hyderabad, India (Oct 2018 – Jul 2021) Projects: Westpac Live, MEDB, Compass(Fintech)

Refined fraud detection logic and backend formulas for accurate results.

Integrated CRUD operations into backend and connected them to frontend interfaces.

Led systematic code migration from C++ to Java.

Implemented backend features using Java, Spring Boot and Microservices, emphasizing clean architecture and compliance with industry standards.

Developed reusable Selenium scripts using BDD/TDD, improving test efficiency by 25%.

Collaborated with business analysts and stakeholders for optimized solutions.

PERSONAL PROJECTS Capstone Project

Built a backend system for modern frontend integration using Mongoose and MongoDB.

Implemented CRUD with filtering, pagination, sorting, and centralized error handling.

Added user authentication, authorization, and WebSocket integration.

Tech Stack: MongoDB, Mongoose, JavaScript

IMDB (Online Movie Booking) Web App

Developed a booking site using fetch API with watchlist/favorites features.

Used React hooks and context APIs for clean code and debugging.

Tech Stack: JavaScript, React, Tailwind CSS

AI Agent

Created an AI Agent using Open AI’s API.

Node.js backend enabling real time conversational AI features

Tech Stack: Node.js,Open AI

CORE COMPETENCIES High-Level Design, UI Design, QA & Testing, Agile Methodologies, Team Collaboration, Project Management, Product Development, Code Optimization, Performance Tuning

TECHNICAL SKILLS Languages: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, C, C++, Java,Spring Boot

Databases: MySQL(Skill Mastery Certification from Scalar.com), MongoDB

Tools: Git, GitHub, Postman, Selenium, Tailwind CSS, Mongoose, Swift,Kafka,Jenkins

Practices: Agile, Maven, Gradle, TDD, BDD, Microservices, System Design

IDE: VS Code, Eclipse

Other: DSA (Intermediate/Advanced) Solved 500+ question on Interview Bit /Scalar, OOP, Machine Coding

ACHIEVEMENTS - Best Team Award – Infosys Limited (2019)

Nominated for Best Utilities (2020) for innovative tools

EDUCATION Bachelor of Engineering (ECE) – 2018

Medi-Caps Institute of Technology and Management, Indore
